notes: Codes with an empty message under `error N` are omitted, not guessed.
For parameterised codes a command-trigger entry overrides the generic `error N` text; `generic` keeps the fallback for comparison.
<name> stands for the variable/command/matrix/file name Stata substitutes at run time.
Codes above 9999 were probed once and carry no message; the sweep therefore stops there.
Long messages (r(900)-r(916)) are truncated to their first line; `extra_lines` records how many lines were dropped.
